audio_access_policy: Only the21 predeclared TRAIN note WAVs opened/hashed; no DEV, SEALED, hammer, resonance-release, or pedal WAV content or header opened. No audio copied.

measurement_definitions.rms: Mean square over both stereo channels, dB relative to full scale1. No normalization, EQ, resampling, onset shifting or denoising.
measurement_definitions.early: 5–500ms from edited file start, excludes documented5ms fade but is not a physical hammer-contact window.
measurement_definitions.tail: Last1second except final100ms (documented release fade). Observed composite signal only, not calibrated mic noise or proof of natural decay. Denoising/fades and hall reverberation confound late power.
measurement_definitions.gate: Exact PCM zero runs >=20ms per channel starting after50ms, reported as digital censor candidates only. Absence does not prove uncensored decay; dither may mask zero runs.
measurement_definitions.clipping: Counts full-scale signed16-bit codes; not an assessment of undocumented prior analog clipping.
measurement_definitions.duplicate_check: Only21 openedTRAIN full-file hashes vs existing Hamburg/NewYork corpus hash metadata; differing format/trim defeats exact-byte comparison. No statistical independence proof.
